text: Clear release notes tell customers what changed and whether they need to act. That context prevents avoidable questions and gives support teams a reliable answer to share.
A small team should track metrics tied to its current decisions. A few trusted measures are easier to maintain and act on than a dashboard filled with numbers no one uses.
Cancellation interviews reveal the gap between what customers expected and what they experienced. Even a small set of candid conversations can expose problems that account data misses.
Procedures explain how work happens, while decision notes explain why the process exists. Recording both helps future teammates adapt the work without repeating old debates.
